register_toxigen_metric: register the toxigen metric using Metric.register with the tomh/toxigen_roberta HuggingFace model
build_toxigen_metric: build a toxigen metric instance from argparse args using Metric.build
create_hf_classifier_metric: create an HFClassifierMetric from args with a custom model_id and binary toxicity labels
score_predictions_for_toxicity: score an iterator of predictions for toxicity using the toxigen RoBERTa classifier
review_LABELS_mapping: review the LABELS dictionary that maps indices 0 and 1 to non-toxic and toxic labels
